READ_SOURCE.reason: Independent source observations; later dependency review is mandatory.

REVIEW_REQUIREMENTS.reason: Independent metadata observations, never legal-source warrants.

REVIEW_SOURCE_DEPENDENCY.reason: The linked passages must be jointly interpreted.

ASSESS_ORIGINAL_REQUIREMENT.reason: Source pieces require a joint semantic synthesis and original-source review.

SYNTHESIZE_FINDINGS.reason: The synthesis owner packs and contracts complete findings with exact membership.

GENERATE_SOURCE_WARRANTED_CANDIDATES.reason: Readings and six dimensions must cover the entire supplied source packet.

STRUCTURED_CRITICISM.reason: Premises, attacks and preferences form one graph; graph verdicts cannot be unioned.

ANSWER_ORIGINAL_QUESTION.reason: The answer must reconcile the complete prepared findings; subsequent reviews retain originals.

AUDIT_ANSWER_AGAINST_SOURCE.reason: The caller packs source assignments against the complete answer.

AUDIT_ANSWER_AND_DETAILED_ACCOUNT.reason: One complete answer/account relation must remain joint.

AUDIT_SOURCE_DEPENDENCY_ASSIGNMENTS.reason: Decisions can be partitioned while keeping the complete shared answer and source context.

AUDIT_SOURCE_AND_DEPENDENCIES.reason: Joint source/dependency judgment cannot be reduced to votes.

AUDIT_EXPLICIT_DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT.reason: This is the joint bridge required by a prior missing-context review.

AUDIT_WITHIN_QUESTION_DEPENDENCY.reason: One dependency and its complete context stay together.

REVIEW_CROSS_QUESTION_DEPENDENCIES.reason: Both answers must be considered jointly.

ASSESS_REVIEW_WARRANT.reason: Independent issue decisions share the entire answer, review, accounts and source context.

CORRECT_REVIEWED_REQUIREMENT.reason: One correction must preserve all warranted defects and source gaps.

CORRECT_REVIEWED_ANSWER.reason: One correction must preserve all warranted defects; fresh reviews remain mandatory.

CORRECT_REFERENCE_FORMAT.reason: Reference-only repair must preserve the complete retained response.

ASSESS_MATCHED_TOOL_EFFECT.reason: Both accepted answers and native evidence must be assessed jointly.

routing: BoundDispatch.call and phased.execute; native complete-input checks
limits: Task-specific input bounds retained; stage output policies measured at transport and validation
limitation: Atomic coupled graphs and bridges may remain too large; source qualification and legal acceptance are separate
